1479-5671-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5671-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

240-2511-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6255--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-3899-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2034-2415-5931.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

4055-7420-7546.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Energy Refractor by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

1170-2196-2701-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-7487.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

223-4285-7411.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{R} plus {3} if Increasing Vengeance is in your graveyard
223-4285-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-4285-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost or its flashback cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Increasing Vengeance copy, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance, targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Increasing Vengeance copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.
223-4285-7411.notes: If you cast Increasing Vengeance for its flashback cost, you'll get an additional copy of Increasing Vengeance each loop. This'll eventually result in infinite copies of Gravitic Punch, meaning you can deal infinite damage to infinite targets.

765-1558-2638-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-4231-4321.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2438-3585-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5342-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5342-5944.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2820-3175-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

81-147-1638-2060.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3443-5056.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-3443-5056.description:
Cause Deathbloom Ritualist to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat from step 2.

969-3101-3292-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
969-3101-3292-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
969-3101-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

141-167-5147.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

2921-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
2921-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
2921-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2292-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2292-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1170-1328-3480-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-3480-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1768-2034-2459-5224.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1768-2034-2459-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Juniper Order Ranger and Rograkh.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
When Rograkh dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

204-776-2909.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least four creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-2909.description:
Activate four creatures you control by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Mind Games to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control five or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

1558-2557-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-2557-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1025-4682.description:
Each time an opponent draws a card, Smothering Tithe triggers.
Opponents will eventually be unable to pay for Smothering Tithe due to Statis causing them to skip their untap steps, causing you to create a Treasure artifact token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis triggers.
Holding priority, activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis ability, paying {U}.
Repeat.

1964-1987-2427-2556.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
